_about: Music Phase 1 step 4: auto-tagger PROPOSALS (tools/music_autotag.py). Not applied to the corpus. Cole: set accept true/false per item (or change tag to one of TAGS); save as cole_out/step4/music_tags_reviewed.json; then tools/step4_dropin.sh applies the accepted tags in one command.
